name: Aconcagua Valley
shape: Chile Decreto 464, drawn from its comunas and provinces

climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A subregion of Chile's Aconcagua wine region, which covers all the vineyards of the Valparaíso Region. It is known for red wines, with white grapes now planted on new coastal sites.
